run_sweep_inference_benchmark: run an inference benchmark sweep across different GPU configurations using SLURM job scheduling
run_sweep_nodes_and_atoms: run a benchmark sweep over different GPU counts and atom counts with SLURM launcher
run_load_config: run a hydra config loader that merges YAML overrides with structured JobConfig defaults
run_calculate_node_gpu_distribution: run a calculation to determine number of nodes and GPUs per node for a total GPU count
run_generate_plots: run generation of weak scaling and strong scaling plots from aggregated benchmark results
